kb_name: CCTV Sabotage / Security Staff Collusion Investigation Knowledge Base

rules.name: DVR / CCTV Forensic Timeline

direction.title: DVR/CCTV Sabotage Forensic Timeline
direction.description: Pull DVR system logs, camera outage sequence, administrator login activity, deleted-footage recovery, power-event logs, and network logs around the outage window to determine whether the sabotage required physical access, remote/admin access, or both.
direction.trigger: CCTV/DVR outage or footage gap coincides suspiciously with the incident window.
cross_match: Admin login account against employee/security-staff roster
Outage timestamp against duty roster for that shift
direction.expected_outcome: Determines whether the outage was a remote hack, a scheduled/maintenance coincidence, or required someone physically present with admin credentials — directly separates 'CCTV Sabotage' from 'Security Staff Collusion'.

rules.why_template: A CCTV outage precisely timed to the incident is either a technical fault or a deliberate act — the DVR's own logs almost always tell you which.

rules.name: Security Staff Duty & Communication Review

direction.title: Security Staff Duty History & Communication Review
direction.description: Review guard duty history, patrol logs, radio/phone communication during the shift, unusual absences, and any deviation from the standard patrol route around the incident window.
direction.trigger: Security collusion hypothesis is active — someone in a security role may have facilitated or ignored the incident.
search_targets: Guard duty roster and patrol logs
cross_match: On-duty guard identity against financial-distress or grievance indicators
Patrol deviation timing against the incident timeline
direction.expected_outcome: Identifies whether the guard on duty deviated from routine in a way consistent with facilitation, or was genuinely absent/distracted.
failure_conditions: Guard genuinely unavailable due to medical/other reason

rules.why_template: If a security staff member facilitated the incident, their own duty and communication records during the shift are the most direct way to confirm or rule it out.
